statements.statement: The claim is for CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring)
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I48.91
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous monitoring is necessary to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
Continuous monitoring is necessary to optimize rate control
Continuous monitoring is necessary to assess arrhythmic burden
